purpose: Original low-poly single-valve fossil-form candidate; not a scan, exact museum replica, articulated bivalve or living appearance. Independent acceptance and release are separate.
subject: Inoceramus genus-level fossil form, anchored to I. stuemckei BGR Ma 14105
coverage_justification: Static-stylized-v1 eight-view coverage plus underside, opposing side, actual-triangle wireframe and umbo/fold detail. Static single valve with no articulated or hidden moving parts.
surface_profile: palette-only, intentionally flat-shaded faceted geometry, single-sided opaque PBR materials

scale.uncertain: Width, thickness, reverse surface and missing outline details are conservative artistic estimates, not measured replica dimensions.

axes.origin: Basal rim mounting contact at floor zero. Upright museum display, not reconstructed life position.

runtime_profile.gpu: required for acceptance, not run by maker
runtime_profile.scene: required for acceptance, composed-scene work deferred to integration

criteria.description: Source/export/rebuild self-containment, outward closed mesh, 180 mm height and bounded budgets.
Broad oblique oval, offset modest umbo, six stepped rounded nested growth folds, flatter adult outer region; no radial scallop fan or rock-matrix lumps.
Single right-valve inspired fossil form; retain supported concentric folds and label unknown reverse/thickness as artistic.
Editable source, deterministic generator/config, standalone GLB, exact-export canonical/diagnostic previews and honest scope.
Pinned Three.js GLTFLoader parses the exact exported GLB and preserves bounds/materials.
Exact artifact rendered in actual target GPU path; no parse-only substitution.
Composed museum scene scale/contact and measured workload checked before production acceptance.
